title: Improve configure UX: no-echo token prompt + non-interactive flags
description:
In configure command, read token without echoing to terminal when interactive, and allow setting token/default space via flags for scripts/CI (optionally still prompting if flags missing).

Workflow:
- Create a new git branch before starting (example: git checkout -b bd/capacities-cli-0d1-configure-ux).
- Prefer TDD where practical: add failing tests first; if stdin/tty makes testing hard, isolate logic into testable functions and start there.
- Run tests (go test ./...). If Go cache permissions are restricted, use: env GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.cache/go-tmp" go test ./...
- Commit when tests pass (single logical commit preferred).

title: Refactor API client: shared request helper + typed API errors
description:
Reduce duplication in internal/api/client.go by introducing a small helper for JSON requests (marshal, set headers, decode, non-200 error handling). Return a typed error that includes status code + response body for better UX and easier tests.

Workflow:
- Create a new git branch before starting (example: git checkout -b bd/capacities-cli-1io-api-client-helper).
- Prefer TDD where practical: write failing tests for helper/error behavior first, then implement/refactor until green.
- Run tests (go test ./...). If Go cache permissions are restricted, use: env GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.cache/go-tmp" go test ./...
- Commit when tests pass (single logical commit preferred).

title: Implement GET /spaces
description: Add GetSpaces to client and spaces command.

title: Fix gosec security issues (2 security warnings)
description:
The golangci-lint gosec linter found 2 security issues:

1. G304 in internal/config/config.go:26 - Potential file inclusion via variable (os.ReadFile with user-controlled path)
2. G301 in internal/config/config.go:46 - Directory permissions should be 0750 or less (currently 0755)

Review these for actual security implications and either fix or add nolint comments with justification.

title: Implement POST /save-weblink
description: Add SaveWebLink to client and save-weblink command.

title: Add JSON output mode for list/search commands
description:
Add a --format (table|json) or --json flag for commands that currently print tables: spaces, space-info, search. Keep table output as default; JSON output should be stable for scripting.

Workflow:
- Create a new git branch before starting (example: git checkout -b bd/capacities-cli-7fz-json-output).
- Prefer TDD where practical: add failing tests first (golden/output tests or unit tests for formatter functions), then implement until green.
- Run tests (go test ./...). If Go cache permissions are restricted, use: env GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.cache/go-tmp" go test ./...
- Commit when tests pass (single logical commit preferred).

title: Daily save: accept stdin / --file
description: Enhance capacities daily save to accept piped stdin when no args are provided, and add a --file flag to read note content from a file. Keep existing positional-arg behavior unchanged and update README usage accordingly.

title: Implement GET /space-info
description: Add GetSpaceInfo to client and space-info command.

title: Add package comments and documentation (34 revive issues)
description:
The golangci-lint revive linter found 34 style/documentation issues:

- Missing package comments in: main, api, cli, config packages
- Missing exported type/function comments throughout codebase
- Unused parameters in: configure.go (ctx), spaces.go (cmd)

Add godoc-style comments for all exported types, functions, and packages. Rename or remove unused parameters.

title: Fix errcheck linter errors (19 unchecked error returns)
description:
The golangci-lint errcheck linter found 19 unchecked error returns in:
- internal/api/client_test.go (19 w.Write calls)
- internal/cli/search.go (3 fmt/Flush calls)
- internal/cli/space_info.go (3 fmt/Flush calls)
- internal/cli/spaces.go (3 fmt/Flush calls)

All error returns should be checked or explicitly ignored with _ = if intentional.

title: Implement POST /search
description: Add Search to client and search command.

title: Taskfile: make go test/build work in restricted cache environments
description:
Some environments can't write to the default Go build cache. Update Taskfile.yml (and/or docs) to use a repo-local GOCACHE/GOTMPDIR (e.g. .cache/) so task test/build works consistently.

Workflow:
- Create a new git branch before starting (example: git checkout -b bd/capacities-cli-ser-taskfile-gocache).
- Prefer TDD where practical: if changing behavior, add a small test or CI-friendly check first; otherwise validate by running tasks locally.
- Run tests (go test ./...). If Go cache permissions are restricted, use: env GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.cache/go-tmp" go test ./...
- Commit when tests pass (single logical commit preferred).

title: Test Framework Setup
description: Set up httptest and write initial tests for SaveToDailyNote.

title: CLI auth/space resolution: env vars + global flags
description:
Support CAPACITIES_TOKEN and CAPACITIES_DEFAULT_SPACE_ID env overrides, and add global flags (e.g. --token, --space-id) so every command can run without config file. Centralize resolution logic to avoid repeated config/token checks.

Workflow:
- Create a new git branch before starting (example: git checkout -b bd/capacities-cli-wnu-cli-auth-flags).
- Prefer TDD where practical: add failing tests first (or add new tests if missing), then implement until green.
- Run tests (go test ./...). If Go cache permissions are restricted, use: env GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.cache/go-tmp" go test ./...
- Commit when tests pass (single logical commit preferred).
